_provenance.note: A forced non-zero exit cannot be recorded from a successful `gh api /user` call — hand-authored to exercise runJson's non-zero-exit throw path (exec.mjs:31-32). whoami has no null-shape fallback, so a failed lookup must REJECT, not resolve to a fabricated { username: undefined } (design D3, issue #385, M10 Phase 2 final Gap-A batch).
